items.name: MatchKind
items.summary: A knob for controlling the match semantics of a packed multiple string searcher.

items.name: Builder
items.summary: A builder for constructing a packed searcher from a collection of patterns.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: fn add<P: AsRef<[u8]>>(&mut self, pattern: P) -> &mut Builder
methods.summary: Add the given pattern to this set to match.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Build a searcher from the patterns added to this builder so far.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<I, P>(&mut self, patterns: I) -> &mut Builder where I: IntoIterator<Item = P>, P: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: Add the given iterator of patterns to this set to match.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of patterns added to this builder.

methods.name: minimum_len
methods.summary: Returns the length, in bytes, of the shortest pattern added.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new builder for constructing a multi-pattern searcher. This constructor uses the default configuration.

items.name: Config
items.summary: The configuration for a packed multiple pattern searcher.

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Create a packed builder from this configuration. The builder can be used to accumulate patterns and create a [`Searcher`] from them.

methods.name: heuristic_pattern_limits
methods.signature: fn heuristic_pattern_limits(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut Config
methods.summary: Request that heuristic limitations on the number of patterns be employed. This useful to disable for benchmarking where one wants to explore how Teddy performs on large number of patterns even if the heuristics would otherwise refuse const…

methods.name: match_kind
methods.signature: fn match_kind(&mut self, kind: MatchKind) -> &mut Config
methods.summary: Set the match semantics for this configuration.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new default configuration. A default configuration uses leftmost-first match semantics.

items.name: FindIter
items.summary: An iterator over non-overlapping matches from a packed searcher.

items.name: Searcher
items.summary: A packed searcher for quickly finding occurrences of multiple patterns.

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fn find<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, haystack: B) -> Option<Match>
methods.summary: Return the first occurrence of any of the patterns in this searcher, according to its match semantics, in the given haystack. The `Match` returned will include the identifier of the pattern that matched, which corresponds to the index of t…

methods.name: find_in
methods.signature: fn find_in<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, haystack: B, span: Span) -> Option<Match>
methods.summary: Return the first occurrence of any of the patterns in this searcher, according to its match semantics, in the given haystack starting from the given position.

methods.name: find_iter
methods.signature: fn find_iter<'a, 'b, B: ?Sized + AsRef<[u8]>>(&'a self, haystack: &'b B) -> FindIter<'a, 'b>
methods.summary: Return an iterator of non-overlapping occurrences of the patterns in this searcher, according to its match semantics, in the given haystack.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.summary: Returns the match kind used by this packed searcher.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the approximate total amount of heap used by this searcher, in units of bytes.

methods.name: minimum_len
methods.summary: Returns the minimum length of a haystack that is required in order for packed searching to be effective.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<I, P>(patterns: I) -> Option<Searcher> where I: IntoIterator<Item = P>, P: AsRef<[u8]>
methods.summary: A convenience function for constructing a searcher from an iterator of things that can be converted to a `&[u8]`.
